name: Silicon
summary: Calibration case of the schema. Few degrees of freedom, but the largest actuation range per degree of freedom: the conductivity can be set over more than ten orders of magnitude. Anyone who wants to check the schema checks it here first, because every number is independently documented.

degrees_of_freedom.description: Carrier density, controllable by doping and by field
Indirect band gap, dependent on temperature and strain

inputs.notes: Field effect; switching energy is device-dependent (C*V^2), not intrinsic to the material
Irreversible in the finished device. The most important case in the schema where reversible=false rules out closed-loop control.

couplings.source: Sze & Ng, Physics of Semiconductor Devices, 3rd ed. (2007)

validity.condition: inversion operation, 2 nm SiO2 equivalent (C = 1.73e-2 F/m^2), sheet charge converted to a 10 nm channel depth
sigma = q * mu * n, mu = 0.14 m^2/(V*s) for electrons at 300 K; scale = q*mu = 2.24e-20
Linearization of the Varshni relation with Varshni's own Si parameters (E0=1.1557 eV, alpha=7.021e-4, beta=1108); yields Eg(300 K) = 1.111 eV
p-Si <110> longitudinal, (pi11+pi12+pi44)/2 = 71.8e-11 Pa^-1 from Smith's tensor components

couplings.notes: The value of 94e-11 carried in v0.1 cannot be found in the primary literature and has been replaced.

validity.condition: n_i = A*exp(-Eg/(2kT)); exponent frozen at 300 K; A calibrated such that n_i(300 K) = 9.65e15 m^-3 with the model's own Eg(300 K) = 1.111 eV

couplings.source: Misiakos & Tsamakis, J. Appl. Phys. 74, 3293 (1993), doi:10.1063/1.354551
couplings.notes: Closes the thermal runaway cycle. Without this edge the feedback loop declared in feedback_loops was broken in the graph - which is exactly what the path check in the linter revealed.

feedback_loops.notes: A higher temperature narrows the gap, raises the intrinsic carrier density and hence the current, which heats further. Limits high-temperature operation. Detected and reported by the evaluator as a positive cycle, not integrated numerically.

gaps: Doping is irreversible in the finished device; a reversible chemical actuation route is missing.
The coupling c_gate_n depends on device geometry and is therefore strictly speaking not a material property. Marked as medium in the schema.
In the exponent of c_gap_ni the temperature is frozen at 300 K. The model underestimates thermal runaway and is only good for demonstrating the sign, not for design.

The band gap of the model is Varshni-consistent (1.111 eV at 300 K) and therefore lies about 9 meV below the common textbook value of 1.12 eV. The deviation is intentional, because slope and absolute value have to come from the same source.
sources: Sze & Ng, Physics of Semiconductor Devices, 3rd ed. (2007)
Misiakos & Tsamakis, J. Appl. Phys. 74, 3293 (1993), doi:10.1063/1.354551
Rowe, arXiv:1309.6445 (compilation of the piezoresistance coefficients)

provenance.notes: Literature search and field extraction by AI agents under the direction of D. Leonforte; every numerical value and citation checked against the cited work and every DOI verified. Not reviewed by a domain expert. Corrections are welcome and are the intended path to improvement.
